critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 923 lines; still recommended to split into routers (leads/calls/documents/files/partners/auth) per prior review.
Documents download uses inline Content-Disposition; UI triggers a blob download client-side. Fine, but attachment disposition + a filename param would harden direct-URL downloads if ever exposed.

Upload endpoint reads entire file into memory before size check; for the 10MB limit that is acceptable, but a streamed check would be cleaner and prevent memory pressure if MAX_DOC_BYTES is ever raised.
Content-type check relies solely on client-provided file.content_type; a magic-byte sniff would prevent a renamed .txt with a spoofed header (not exploitable now, defense-in-depth).
LeadDetail.jsx now 437 lines with FileCard + DocumentsCard + CallModal wrapper; splitting DocumentsCard into its own file would help maintainability.
